_doc: Oracle bounds per SIGNAL family (facts.md §11, kb/data/screens/CEILING.md — research session, 2026-08-31): the most a family can add on the live_07 champion (BPR + 5-seed average, valid 0.6041) measured with information no legal model has. distill.calibrate() applies them to cards that have no measurement yet (rule ADR-0018) and adds a `ceiling:oracle` Measured line to every mapped card; the ledger (families.json) absorbs this file.
